title: Match of the Day
synopsis_short: Highlights of seven Premier League matches, including Arsenal's trip to Sunderland.
synopsis_medium: Highlights of seven Premier League matches, including Sunderland at home to champions Arsenal, Liverpool against Fulham, now managed by former Red Alvaro Arbeloa, and Hull's visit to Chelsea.
synopsis_long:
Highlights of seven Premier League matches, including champions Arsenal who travel to Sunderland. Last season’s match at the Stadium of Light finished 2-2 after a 94th-minute equaliser from Sunderland’s Brian Brobbey. 

Liverpool face a Fulham side managed by former Reds defender Alvaro Arbeloa. Newly promoted Hull face a tough trip to Chelsea, whilst fellow new boys Ipswich go to Crystal Palace. Elsewhere, Spurs host Everton, Bournemouth meet Brentford, and Aston Villa welcome Nottingham Forest to Villa Park.
synopsis_editorial: With Sunderland v Arsenal, Chelsea v Hull, Spurs v Everton and Liverpool v Fulham
